We are no longer updating this data. It is best suited for historical research and analysis.

 

This historic dataset delineates valley segments based on a number of different natural features. The data applies to valley segments on the Ontario side of the Great Lakes.

 

ALIS has also been incorporated into the Aquatic Ecosystem Classification: Great Lakes Basin and Wetlands Data Class and the Great Lakes Conservation Blueprint for Aquatic Biodiversity datasets.

 

*[ALIS]: Aquatic Landscape Inventory System

 
Status
Obsolete: data is no longer relevant
 
Maintenance and Update Frequency
Not planned: there are no plans to update the data
